text_block_list.text:
—Lately, the academy has been buzzing with 
a certain rumor.

An exchange race using the VR Umalator is 
going to be held with overseas horse girls 
who have competed in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is this it? The "Exchange Race Selected 
Candidates List"...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...My name's not on it. Well, guess that's 
how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. Did I look uninterested to 
you, coming all the way just to check this 
list?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—You bet your ass I am. Like hell I'm 
letting this slip away.
choice_data_list:
But there's nothing we can do at this 
point...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, doing it by the book won't get us 
anywhere. Which leaves only one answer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —We do something that ain't by the book.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...Late. It is already starting time, no? 
I heard Japanese people were strict about 
time..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Yo. Kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hello... You are today's opponent? 
...Where are the other girls?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nobody else is showing up except me.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Scheduled to Run A
text_block_list.text: —Haah, haah... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Yo.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Scheduled to Run A
text_block_list.text:
...Who're you? I'm kind of in the middle 
of training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got some spirit, I see. Puts a smile on my 
face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—To tell you the truth. I came here to 
knock you flat.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Scheduled to Run B
text_block_list.text:
...Kh, haah... haah...! You... When I saw 
you around the academy... you were never 
this fast—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—That was pretty fun. Still... looks like 
I win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —One down. And... another.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Every single one scheduled to race you... 
I've already blown right past 'em and shut 
'em down. So yeah, no one's coming except 
me.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...That does not sound like the words of a 
sane person. Just who are you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. ...Or maybe, I feel like I 
might just be the exact same breed as you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—A thrilling, skin-crawling showdown. Just 
a damn idiot who lives for nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...So then. Will you take this idiot's 
challenge? Or are you... gonna turn tail 
and run?

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. I shall take you on...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...HAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"—Kh, not bad...! This is getting 
interesting...!"

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: "Haah, haah... How... absurd...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Kh-kh-kh-kh... Ha-ha-ha-ha...!! Oh yeah... 
This feeling right here, this is what I 
wanted...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... You've got great eyes on ya... hey.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this again. Next time—on the real 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: "—DO NOT UNDERESTIMATE MEEEE!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Haah, haah...! It can't... be... For 
me... to lose...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the duel. Though, just by a 
hair—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I had a few more screws loose 
than you did.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Kh-kh-kh-kh, hahahahaha!!!! Man, this is a 
blast!! Ain't it, hey?!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... What is the meaning of 
this...?! We haven't... crossed the goal 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...No need to bluff. You're already broken 
inside, ain'tcha... Your spirit, that is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...A taste of the real deal... I guess you 
can only truly get that on a real stage.
